about: The MASK WARS shared list for NEAR mainnet. vault: the house's vault, the arena's daily safe; the house makes it again under the same name for every round, so its rounds are never listed: a check reads the round from the vault itself, and gives the vault its label only once the chain confirms the vault's team is the house, its arbiter the bounty contract and its code one that contract lists. arena: live safes on the arena; what happened to each is read from the chain on every check, never from this file. Season 0 adds its safes in the order their rounds open, right after each opens: every round of season.maskwars.near on bounty.maskwars.near (safes s0001.season.maskwars.near, s0002, ...) and every round the team opens by hand (safes h0001.maskwars.near, ...), each by `pnpm --filter @maskwars/check add-safe --network mainnet` and a pull request. reports: accounts reported with evidence, added by pull request.

arena.note: Live safe of race-0001, a round the team opened: a training target with a planted hole, open to the round's masks only.
